caption: The drawing features a single object, a barrel-shaped vessel located in the center of the image. The vessel is outlined in a light pencil on a plain, cream-colored background. The surface of the vessel is decorated with a garland-like banner that curves across its body, bearing the words "Affection's Offering" in cursive script. Above and below the banner, there are stylized floral designs consisting of circular flowers with petals and leaves arranged around them, all drawn in the same light pencil line as the rest of the image. Near the bottom left corner of the drawing, the name "FRANK KEANE" is written in small, uppercase letters. There are no additional objects or colors in the drawing aside from the pencil lines and the background.
title: American "Bohemian" Glass Mug
